newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro traders say Iraq bought U.S wheat, seeks more.
newsitem.headline: Euro traders say Iraq bought U.S wheat, seeks more.

text.p: Iraq has bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat, European grain exporters said on Wednesday.
The deal, completed with a Turkish trading company several days ago, was priced around $187 per tonne including cost and freight, a level widely seen as competitive, they said.
Rival firms had offered wheat at a tender for more than $200 per tonne but Baghdad rejected this, one trader said.
Iraq is now tendering for another 50,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for May shipment, the exporters said.
U.S. traders had said overnight that Iraq appeared not to have bought wheat at its original March 11 tender and would retender this week for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter.
